text: Large multi-feature requests are split into a foundation issue plus one issue per feature, each linked to the foundation and the original request.
child-page parent-facing Settings sit behind a simple-sum parent gate and are reached via a quiet gear icon on the main menu only, never inside activities.

child-page menu configuration (enabled activities and their order) is stored as one full ordered list of all activities; disabled ones keep their position and unknown/new activities are appended enabled; disabled activities are unreachable via history or hash routes.

child-page new activities each get their own issue with a menu tile, Settings activity-list entry (enabled, appended at the end), reduced-motion support and a neutral no-failure interaction model; menu layout for many tiles is a separate foundation issue.

child-page README is written in English with Polish activity names; every new activity must be added to the README Activities section with a short description, and the activity count in the intro must stay correct.

child-page learning activities have no wrong answers or failure feedback: incorrect moves drift back gently, success is only a soft glow, nothing is scored or stored, meaning is carried by pictures/shapes (numerals only for counting), with a keyboard alternative and a non-colour cue where colour matters.

child-page 'gentle' activities that could fail (e.g. block tower) are designed so failure is impossible: towers never collapse, wrong drops drift back, empty/hidden states are friendly, and expressions never include angry/sad faces.

child-page: every skill activity states its numeric parameters (counts, durations, minimum 48-72px targets) in the issue, rounds repeat with new content, and text is limited to numerals or small parent-facing words (e.g. Literki).

child-page: when asked for many 'similar but different' activities, vary the play mechanic (in-place rotation, character path, pendulum, free-drag follow, sweep gesture, reveal doors), not just the vehicle, and keep each as its own issue with numeric parameters, 56px targets and a unique CSS prefix.

child-page: big 'variety/randomisation' batch requests are split into a small shared-helper foundation issue plus one issue per activity (plain 'pick N animals' activities grouped in one issue), a separate bug-batch issue, and 'no change' items dropped; ask the human to resolve contradictory numbers (grid sizes, card counts) before writing.

child-page analytics/usage-metrics: stay on-device (anonymous daily aggregates in localStorage, no network, no third-party trackers), shown and exported only from the parent-gated Settings, with a reset; activities report only through one shared module.

child-page: when a theme (e.g. dogs) spawns several new activities, open a shared-assets foundation issue first (e.g. breed drawings in one data file) and give each activity a different play mechanic (wash, race, fetch, feed).

child-page: every new-activity issue must include acceptance criteria for usage metrics (report only via window.Analytics: track('interaction'), complete() where a clear completion exists) and a per-activity doc in docs/activities/ built from ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md.

child-page: menu 'favourites' are parent-only (star toggle in gated Settings, labelled 'Ulubione' section above the regular tiles, each activity shown once, no child control); stored with the swa.menu config and cleared by reset.
